bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 69.2% of Monday's sales, while the 7-day off-plan share stood at 65.2%.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the last 30 days and up 1.0% compared to last year.
Over the past 7 days, the busiest areas for sales were Dubai South with 290 sales, JVC with 188 sales, and Majan with 126 sales.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, rising 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: Azizi's development in Dubai Studio City has reached 62 percent completion, which helps track project delivery timelines for buyers.
Dubai completed 104 projects worth $29.3 billion in H1 2026, showing significant completed supply entering the market and impacting inventory levels.
Ready home prices in International City Phase 1 rose 7.8% over the last 90 days, while Palm Jumeirah increased by 6.5%.
